user: Bicep modular em infra/bicep/ (network, security, data, apps, main) com parâmetros segregados
Isolamento Zero Trust com Private Endpoints e Private DNS Zones para PaaS sem IPs públicos
API Gateway YARP (.NET 8) em src/Pix.Gateway/ integrado à solution e ao docker-compose.yml (porta 8080)
Propagação transparente de cabeçalhos de segurança (Authorization Bearer) e rastreamento W3C (traceparent)
Azure SQL Database com réplica síncrona habilitada para leituras de saldo com ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly
Conformidade com testes automatizados de linter Bicep, roteamento e saúde do Gateway

featureStatuses.NOT_STARTED: Feature is in the backlog but execution has not started.
featureStatuses.IN_PROGRESS: Feature is currently in the planning, implementation, or validation phase.
featureStatuses.COMPLETED: Feature successfully passed all validation score gates.
featureStatuses.BLOCKED: Feature failed validation and exceeded maximum rework attempts, or a dependency is blocked (e.g. application crash or critical break).
featureStatuses.FAILED: Feature did not reach score thresholds after maximum reworks, but did not crash the application, allowing development to continue and be reviewed later.

taskStatuses.NOT_STARTED: Task is defined but implementation has not yet begun.
taskStatuses.IN_PROGRESS: Task is currently being executed by the development agent.
taskStatuses.COMPLETED: Task implementation is complete and all tests pass.
taskStatuses.BLOCKED: Task cannot be completed because its parent feature is blocked.
taskStatuses.FAILED: Task failed validation and acceptance criteria along with its parent feature, but does not block development progression.
